title: TEDDY
text: Since Teddy relies several bioinformatics packages Bioconductor, need install dependencies first installing Teddy package . Step 1: Install Dependencies (R console) Please open R console run following commands ensure required packages installed: Note Reference Genomes: Teddy uses mouse genome (mm10) default parameter functions. working species (e.g., Human hg38), need install corresponding BSgenome package specify function arguments. Step 2: Install Teddy (Terminal) dependencies installed preparation step complete, return terminal. Navigate back parent directory install package: (Note: already navigated inside Teddy folder, use R CMD INSTALL . instead.)
code: # Install BiocManager if not already installed if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {     install.packages("BiocManager") }  # Install required dependencies from Bioconductor bioc_deps <- c(   "rtracklayer", "GenomicFeatures", "Rsamtools",    "GenomicAlignments", "GenomicRanges", "IRanges",    "S4Vectors", "SummarizedExperiment", "Rsubread",    "DESeq2", "statmod", "BiocParallel", "MatrixGenerics" ) BiocManager::install(bioc_deps)  # Install the default mouse genome package used by Teddy BiocManager::install("BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10") cd ../.. R CMD INSTALL Teddy

what: 3.7 Detect to what extent TE-chimeric exon affect the expression of the corresponding transcript
title: TEDDY
text: 3.7.1 Fit counts formula ~sample + TE-chimeric + condition:TE-chimeric compare null model ~ sample + TE-chimeric. TE-chimeric factor two levels, classified exon TE-chimeric exon exon. Compare deviances two GLM fits counting bin χ2-distribution test extract result test. 3.7.2 Estimate relative fold changes counts TE-chimeric exon among different conditions versus exons, calculated GLM fit based formula count ~ condition + TE-chimeric + condition:TE-chimeric. interaction coefficient reflects fraction gene’s reads TE-chimeric exon differs significantly different experimental conditions. , TE-chimeric transcripts may play role different biological conditions.
code: chi_test <- ChimericDrivenTest(SEobject = se, condition = condition) results <- extractTest(object = chi_test) calculateFoldchange(object = chi_test, genes = genes, crossVar="condition")
